description: Fix results display and player selector overlay: 1) Transform backend analytics to PlayerMetrics[] format so AnalyticsDashboard and FieldView display data correctly. 2) Position PlayerSelector absolutely over VideoPlayer so users can draw selection rectangles on the video.
steps: Fix backend/src/services/background_tasks.py: Transform AnalyticsResult into PlayerMetrics[] format with route_points, sprint_segments, distances, speeds
Fix frontend/src/pages/AnalysisPage.tsx: Wrap VideoPlayer and PlayerSelector in a relative-positioned container, position PlayerSelector absolutely over the video
Add frontend result transformation as fallback in WebSocket message handler to convert backend results into TrackingResult format
acceptance_criteria: Backend results_dict includes a 'players' array with full PlayerMetrics data (total_distance_km, max_speed_kmh, avg_speed_kmh, sprint_count, sprints, route)
AnalyticsDashboard displays distance, speeds, sprints for each player when processing completes
FieldView displays player routes on the field map when processing completes
PlayerSelector canvas is overlaid on top of the video player
User can draw selection rectangles directly on the video
